title: Bhai se milaade
body:
nana bhai se milaade
<<DIVIDER>>
chod ke maqtal mein aayi hoo
nana bhai se milaade
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoore ko aisa ujdi
bhai se chooti ghazi se bichdi
akbar barchi khaaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban baba thay aaye
mai beparda sar ko jhukaye
roti thi mai sharmeine
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagte thay durre chinti thi chadar
rote thay bacche ye keh keh kar
ghazi kyun nahi aaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se chali thi bhai ko lekar
jaaun mai kaise sab ko kho kar
dil mera ghabraye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka maqsad aise bachaya
pusht pe durre maine khaaya
bacche yaad na aaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum apna ghar baar luta kar
jalte huwe qaime se bacha kar
deen ko tere laaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataun mai wo manzar
seene pe qatil halq pe khanjar
kyun ye din dikhlaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dua zehra ki tum ko
nauhakhan o matamdaro
aanch na tum par aaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin ki hai khwahish zahra
jitna ho dushman ka pehra
aap ko nauha sunaye
nana bhai se milaade...
author: Toosi Zangipuri
